_note: The learner fills the image placeholder in the editor; the smoke runner does the same substitution with sed before applying. imagePullPolicy=Always forces a re-pull of the mutable samples/hello-dcs:1.0 tag. verify-scc-restricted is environment-sensitive: CRC's portless session SCC may differ from a real DCS session, so it is expected to be informative rather than green everywhere. The SCC page asks for a root container on purpose: the refusal message names every SCC and why each said no, which is the lesson. verify-root-rejected therefore asserts an ABSENCE — a 'rootme' Pod existing would mean the cluster admits root containers.

steps.run: sed -i 's|REPLACE_WITH_HARBOR_IMAGE|${DCS_REGISTRY}/samples/hello-dcs:1.0|' deployment.yaml && envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s
oc set env deploy/hello-dcs --from=configmap/hello-dcs-config && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=150s

cat <<'YAML' | oc apply -f - 2>&1 | tail -4 || true
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: rootme
spec:
  containers:
  - name: c
    image: ${DCS_REGISTRY}/samples/hello-dcs:1.0
    securityContext:
      runAsUser: 0
YAML
for s in restricted-v2 anyuid privileged; do printf '%-14s %s\n' "$s" "$(oc auth can-i use scc/$s 2>/dev/null | tail -1)"; done
